opencode.supported_min_source: oldest version on which recursive (domain-nested) SKILL.md discovery was verified with `opencode debug skill`; not re-tested in this pass, so the floor is left where the evidence put it
opencode.verification_method: opencode --version on the maintainer machine (1.18.11), exercised live: opencode debug skill / debug agent / debug config against this repo and against throwaway sandboxes; agent + config field shapes cross-checked against the published JSON Schema at https://opencode.ai/config.json. latest_known from registry.npmjs.org/opencode-ai dist-tags.latest (1.18.18, published 2026-08-13). validated_against is deliberately not latest_known: 1.18.11 is the build actually run, and asserting 1.18.18 would be invention.

capability_gaps.hooks: OpenCode has no hooks.json; its only lifecycle mechanism is the JS/TS plugin API, and this repo ships no plugin module by design (it would add a Node runtime dependency for no other gain). As installed, the hooks/ guards do not run at all — 'adapter' would imply a generated artifact exists, as it does for subagents, and none does.
capability_gaps.plugin_marketplace: No plugin marketplace — install is by absolute skills.paths. Not by symlink: OpenCode does not follow them for skill discovery (see the skills row).

gemini_cli.supported_min_source: Gemini CLI documents no minimum for extensions; the floor is the version the adapter was actually exercised on rather than guessed
gemini_cli.verification_method: gemini --version on the maintainer machine (0.55.1); extension format, skill discovery depth, agent validation, and hook config shape measured directly with a probe extension linked into an isolated HOME. Gemini reads skills exactly one level below a skills root, so the canonical two-level skills/<domain>/<name>/ tree resolved to zero; scripts/build-gemini-extension.sh generates a flat symlink mirror at .gemini/skills/ plus translated sub-agents at .gemini/agents/, both committed and drift-checked. Verified live: 30 of 30 skills discovered, all 10 agents load with zero errors. Registry key is gemini_cli (not gemini) so this file, core/capabilities/platforms.json and platforms/gemini/adapter.yaml all name the same platform id.

capability_gaps.plugin_marketplace: Gemini installs extensions from a git URL; there is no marketplace listing to publish to.

capability_source_note: targets.<key>.capabilities and capability_gaps are DERIVED from the capability registry and must not be hand-edited. Regenerate with `bash scripts/check-platform-targets.sh . --sync-capabilities`; `scripts/check-feature-equivalence.sh` fails when they drift.
